candidate.role: immutable topology and volume starting point; never likeness authority or direct runtime input

primary_trace.role: sole primary-view likeness, silhouette and landmark authority

topology_policy.starting_mesh: retain the dominant raw v05 component and every material primary-trace-intersecting component in one editable working copy
allowed: local face deletion, creation and merge on the existing working surface
local retopology of an existing semantic region

passes.primary_goal: restore the broad grounded front drape, low underbody, six descending dorsal sac arcs and thick support contacts from the existing v05 topology
passes.diagnostic_goal: preserve one cohesive organic mass without a planar camera card or disconnected replacement volumes

passes.primary_goal: preserve the accepted primary composition while repairing visible thinness, collisions and detached forms
passes.diagnostic_goal: give all major masses coherent thickness and grounded contacts

passes.region: existing rear tail and filament surface
passes.primary_goal: keep the rear tail subordinate to shell masses and remove generated debris that competes with the primary silhouette
passes.diagnostic_goal: retain intentional trailing forms without floating fragments

review_gate.before_each_pass: the required predecessor must have an audit receipt and a recorded continue decision
review_gate.after_each_pass: capture primary, silhouette, trace, opposite, front, side and elevated-rear frames; an independent reviewer records continue or rollback before another pass
review_gate.acceptance: contour overlay and normal visual review are mandatory; scalar metrics diagnose only and cannot accept or rank the mesh
